model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в средната абсолютна стойност на скритото състояние (Hidden State Mean) по слоевете на модел, като представя три различни линии. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и обхваща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, с етикети през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20), като скалата е линейна. Оста Y е обозначена като „Abs Mean" и обхваща диапазон от 0 до 4, с етикети през интервали от 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4), също с линейна скала. Заглавието на фигурата е „Hidden State Mean".

Първата линия, представена в синьо с пунктиран стил, съответства на „hidden state mean before gate" със средна стойност (avg) 0.71, както е посочено в легендата. Тя започва при стойност близо до 0 при слой 0, остава на ниски стойности до приблизително слой 5, след което постепенно намалява леко и достига минимум около слоеве 15–18, където стойностите са близки до 0. След слой 18 линията рязко нараства, достигайки стойност от приблизително 0.5–1 при последните слоеве около 22–23.

Втората линия, представена в оранжево с точков (пунктиран) стил, съответства на „hidden state mean after gate" със средна стойност 0.05. Тя започва при стойност близо до 0 при слой 0 и остава много близо до 0 по протежение на всички слоеве, като практически не показва видими отклонения от нулата.

Третата линия, представена в зелено с плътен стил, съответства на „hidden state mean of baseline" със средна стойност 0.04. Подобно на оранжевата линия, тя започва при стойност близо до 0 при слой 0 и остава много близо до 0 по протежение на целия диапазон на слоевете, без забележими върхове или спадове. Оранжевата и зелената линии визуално се припокриват в голяма степен поради сходните си стойности, близки до нулата.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure displays the "Hidden State Mean" across different layers of a model, comparing three quantities: the hidden state mean before gate (with an average of 0.71), the hidden state mean after gate (with an average of 0.05), and the hidden state mean of baseline (with an average of 0.04). The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 4, with major tick marks at intervals of 1 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The figure is rendered with a three-dimensional perspective, giving the plot a tilted appearance. The blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before gate; it starts near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively low and close to 0 through approximately layer 10, then begins to decrease further (dipping below 0 into slightly negative territory) around layers 12–18, before rising sharply upward at the final layers, reaching a value near approximately 0.5–1 at around layer 23. The orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after gate; it starts near 0 at layer 0 and remains very close to 0 across all layers, essentially flat and barely distinguishable from the baseline. The green solid line represents the hidden state mean of baseline; it also starts near 0 at layer 0 and follows a trajectory very close to 0 throughout, showing a very slight gradual decline toward slightly negative values at later layers, remaining nearly indistinguishable from the after-gate line across the full range of layers.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the hidden state mean across layers of a model, comparing three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to approximately 23 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and ranges from 0 to approximately 4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot title is "Hidden State Mean." Three lines are shown: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and a green solid line representing "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The blue dashed line starts near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively low through approximately layer 5, then begins to decrease slightly before showing a notable dip around layers 10–17 where it drops below 0, followed by a sharp increase in the final layers (around layers 20–23) where it rises to approximately 0.5 or higher. The orange dotted line and the green solid line both start near 0 at layer 0 and remain very close to 0 throughout all layers, with the orange dotted line largely overlapping the green solid line, making them difficult to distinguish from each other across most of the x-axis range. Both the orange and green lines show minimal variation and stay near the zero baseline throughout the entire layer range.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt den Verlauf des mittleren Absolutwerts von Hidden States über die Schichten eines Modells hinweg, wobei der Titel „Hidden State Mean" lautet. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet und erstreckt sich auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet und reicht auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis etwa 4, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4. Das Diagramm wird in einer leicht perspektivischen 3D-Ansicht dargestellt. Es sind drei Linien enthalten: Die erste Linie, dargestellt als blaue gestrichelte Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean before gate" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0.71; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe einem Wert von etwa 0, bleibt bis etwa Layer 8 relativ niedrig, fällt dann leicht ab und steigt ab etwa Layer 18 deutlich an, wobei sie bei Layer 23 einen Wert von ungefähr 0.5 bis 1 erreicht. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt als orange gepunktete Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.05; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0 und bleibt über alle Schichten hinweg sehr nahe bei 0, wobei sie kaum von der Nulllinie abweicht. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt als grüne durchgezogene Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean of baseline" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.04; auch sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0 und verläuft über alle Schichten hinweg praktisch auf der Nulllinie, nahezu deckungsgleich mit der orangen Linie.
